concepts.name: metaReasoning
concepts.description: Thinking about thinking; reasoning about knowledge, reasoning, and learning.

concepts.name: mistake
concepts.description: An error in knowledge, reasoning, or learning.

concepts.name: knowledgeGap
concepts.description: Missing knowledge required to complete reasoning or learning.

concepts.name: learningGoal
concepts.description: A goal generated to acquire missing knowledge.

concepts.name: strategy
concepts.description: A reasoning or learning method available to an agent.

concepts.name: goal
concepts.description: A desired objective pursued by the agent.

concepts.name: configuration
concepts.description: State of the agent's knowledge and reasoning process.

assertions.name: goodMetaReasoning
assertions.description: Mistakes and gaps are identified, appropriate strategies are selected or integrated, and reasoning adapts to new goals.
assertions.property: mistakeDetected AND learningGoalGenerated AND strategySelected AND strategyIntegrated AND goalAdapted
